parameters.query:
SELECT
  d.id AS draft_id,
  d.idea_id,
  d.keyword_cluster_id,
  d.title,
  d.meta_title,
  d.meta_description,
  d.tags,
  d.content_markdown,
  d.status AS draft_status,
  d.word_count,
  d.featured_image_url,
  d.featured_image_alt,
  d.featured_image_prompt,
  d.qa_passed,
  d.created_at,
  d.updated_at,
  i.idea_title,
  i.categoria AS idea_categoria,
  i.status AS idea_status,
  k.project_name,
  k.cluster_name,
  k.keyword_principal,
  k.keywords_secundarias
FROM drafts d
JOIN ideas i ON d.idea_id = i.id
JOIN keywords k ON d.keyword_cluster_id = k.id
WHERE {{ $json.whereClause }}
ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, d.created_at DESC
LIMIT {{ $json.limit }}

=UPDATE drafts
SET
  featured_image_url = $1,
  featured_image_alt = $2,
  featured_image_prompt = $3,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $4
RETURNING id, featured_image_url, featured_image_alt, featured_image_prompt, updated_at

INSERT INTO jobs_log (
  job_name, job_type, status,
  related_keyword_id, related_idea_id, related_draft_id,
  started_at, completed_at, duration_ms,
  input_data, output_data
)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3,
  $4, $5, $6,
  $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, $9::bigint,
  $10::jsonb, $11::jsonb
)
RETURNING id, job_name, status, created_at;
